repos.name: ai-job-search
repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.description_zh: 在你的机器上运行的求职助手。基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 求职框架：评估招聘信息、定制简历、撰写求职信、准备面试。Fork 它，将它据为己有。

repos.name: security-audit-skill
repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.description_zh: 一个面向编程智能体的技能，用于多阶段安全审计，产出经独立核验、机器可读的审计发现。

repos.name: orca
repos.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.description_zh: Orca 是管理一整队并行智能体的 ADE（智能体开发环境）。用你自己的订阅即可运行任意编程智能体，桌面、移动端与 VPS 均可用。

repos.name: ponytail
repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repos.description_zh: 让你的 AI 智能体像团队里最懒的资深开发者那样思考：最好的代码，是你根本没写的那些代码。

repos.name: ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repos.description_zh: 最强大、模块化的扩散模型 GUI、API 与后端，采用图/节点接口。

repos.name: ruflo
repos.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
repos.description_zh: 🌊 原初的智能体元编排框架。部署智能的多智能体集群，协调自主工作流，并构建对话式 AI 系统。具备自适应记忆、自学习智能、RAG 集成，并原生集成 Claude Code / Codex / Hermes 等众多平台。

repos.name: graphify
repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.description_zh: 将任意代码库及其文档、SQL 模式、配置与 PDF 转化为可查询的知识图谱。一款面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 与 Gemini CLI 的 /graphify 技能：本地确定性 AST 解析，每条关系边都有解释，无需向量数据库。

repos.name: agency-agents
repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repos.description_zh: 指尖上的完整 AI 代理公司——从前端巫师到 Reddit 社群高手，从灵感注入器到现实校验员。每个智能体都是带个性、有流程、交付可验证成果的专精专家。

repos.name: headroom
repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.description_zh: 在工具输出、日志、文件与 RAG 文本块抵达 LLM 之前进行压缩：编码智能体可少用约 20% 的 token，JSON 可少用 60–95%，答案保持不变。提供库、代理与 MCP 服务器三种形态。

repos.name: knowledge-work-plugins
repos.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
repos.description_zh: 主要面向知识工作者、用于在 Claude Cowork 中使用的开源插件仓库。

repos.name: agents
repos.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi
repos.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、GitHub Copilot、Google Antigravity 与 Pi 的跨宿主智能体插件市场。

repos.name: agentic-awesome-skills
repos.description: AAS Core is the local, agent-first control plane for complete catalog discovery, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and planning, backed by 2,600+ agentic skills. Includes CLI, local MCP, catalog, plugins, and Workbench.
repos.description_zh: AAS Core 是一套本地优先、以智能体为中心的管控平面，提供完整的技能目录发现、智能体自主选型、技术栈校验与规划能力，背后是 2,600+ 个智能体技能。包含 CLI、本地 MCP、目录、插件与 Workbench 工作台。

repos.name: Kronos
repos.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
repos.description_zh: Kronos：读懂金融市场「语言」的基础模型。

repos.name: vllm
repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repos.description_zh: 面向大语言模型的高吞吐、显存高效的推理与服务引擎。
